compatibility_proof.method: direct code comparison between the request payload MigrationGetTransactionAdapter (src/acquisition/b2w_projection.py) issues and the request payload the committed HeliusB2BTTransport.get_transaction() (src/acquisition/b2bt_execution_boundary.py) issues to Helius
compatibility_proof.conclusion: Helius, via the helius-mainnet-json-rpc endpoint family and the getTransaction JSON-RPC method, is PROVEN COMPATIBLE with B2N's exact migration-lineage request shape by direct comparison against a committed, already-implemented Helius transport class (HeliusB2BTTransport) that issues the byte-for-byte identical method+params[1] shape for the same purpose (fetching a Solana transaction by signature). This is NOT an inference from the differently-shaped B2Z 3-call execution_contract; it is a comparison of the getTransaction call shape alone, which both the B2N adapter and a real Helius transport class already use identically.
compatibility_proof.caveat: No live HTTP call was made to confirm Helius actually accepts/returns this shape at the network level; this proof is limited to static code comparison of what this repository's own committed Helius transport already sends for the identical RPC method.

required_response_fields: result.transaction.message.accountKeys (list containing the member's mint as a pubkey)
result.slot (optional, extracted as provider_slot if present)

cache_hit_semantics.handled_at_layer: B2NExecutor/OneRequestResponse generic plumbing, not MigrationGetTransactionAdapter itself (the committed adapter always issues exactly one request; a caching-aware wrapper would need to be a separate, not-yet-committed client)
cache_hit_semantics.provenance_still_required: a CACHE_HIT does not bypass evidence validation -- B2N-P2 design contract explicitly makes cache hits non-qualifying for creator-funding purposes; for migration-lineage purposes a cache hit still requires the cached response to have satisfied the same account-key/mint check before being cached

malformed_non_success_handling: fail closed: B2NExecutor.run() breaks the member loop on any outcome != SUCCESS or where migration_lineage_evidence_observed/provenance_complete are not both true; no retry, no substitute member, no silent continuation
